name: Ieasysell-AI Chatbot & Live Avatar for WordPress
author: ieasysell

sections.description:
Ieasysell-through AI driven digital human guidance, enhance your visitor conversion and retention rates，1.Engage and convert your shoppers with engaging and immersive video experiences.2.Use video for meaningful customer connections and link online shoppers.3.AI sales assistant gives tailored advice, anticipating customer needs.4.Use existing product information to automatically generate sales scriptsAI enables platforms to deliver tailored experiences—such as product recommendations to thousands of users.
Key features:
* One-click connection to ieasysell.com
* Status sync (connected / AI embedded)
* Embeds management dashboard in wp-admin
* Optional WooCommerce products REST endpoint for integrations

External Services

This plugin relies on third-party external services to provide Digital Human embedding functionality.

  • Service Name: IEasySell Digital Human Service
  • Service Provider: Ieasysell (www.ieasysell.com)
  • Purpose: This service is used to load and render interactive digital human video components on the frontend of WordPress websites to enhance user engagement and sales conversion.
  • Data Transmission Description:
    • Content Sent: When pages containing digital human components are loaded, the plugin sends requests to app.ieasysell.com to load necessary JavaScript resources (digital-human-embed.js). Depending on the implementation of this service, user IP addresses, User-Agent strings, and the current page URL may be sent to properly render content and analyze usage. If user input occurs during digital human interactions, related data may also be transmitted to that server for processing.
    • Timing: Data is only sent when visitors access pages containing the digital human component and their browsers execute the embedded script.
    • Conditions: The connection will be established as long as the administrator has enabled the digital human feature in the plugin settings and placed it on a page.
      *Privacy Policy: https://app.ieasysell.com/private/chinesePrivate.html

Note: Using this feature indicates your agreement with the above third-party terms of service and privacy policy. It’s recommended to inform your website visitors before enabling this feature.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin in WordPress
  3. Go to wp-admin menu “ieasysell” and follow the connection flow
sections.faq:
Does it require WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce is only required if you use the /products REST endpoint.
